title: 'Isekai Tensei Soudouki' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ryousen Takami 's Isekai Tensei Soudouki ( Multi-Mind Mayhem ) novel revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, a second key visual (pictured), and second promotional video on Friday.

title: CyberAgent Expands Production Network With Latent One Launch and MAPPA Partnership
content: CyberAgent is expanding its presence in Japan's animation industry through a combination of studio development and strategic investment, establishing a new animation studio under its subsidiary Colorful Palette while entering a business alliance with MAPPA .
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Draw This, Then Die!' Manga Takes 2-Month Break to Prepare for Final Arc
content: The December issue of Shogakukan 's Monthly Shonen Sunday ( Gessan ) magazine revealed on Thursday that Minoru Toyoda 's Draw This, Then Die! ( Kore Kaite Shine ) manga will take a hiatus for two months so that Toyoda can prepare for the final arc of the manga, as well as work on the manga's upcoming book volumes.
author: ANN

title: The F1 Japanese Grand Prix Names Cygames a Founding Partner
content: Cygames, Inc., Umamusume: Pretty Derby ‘s publisher, is now a founding partner of the 2027 FIA Formula 1 Lenovo Japanese Grand Prix. The partnership marks the first time that the F1 Japanese Grand Prix has had a founding partner.
author: Anime Corner

title: Comic Market: Ticketpay Service Restricts Access for International Users
content: The staff for the Comic Market ( Comiket ) dōjinshi event in Japan reported on Wednesday that the Japanese ticketing service Ticketpay is banning access from users outside of Japan "for the forseeable future to guard against cyberattacks." title: Yuri Is My Job! Manga Gets Short Drama Adaptation Next Spring
content: Donuts announced on Friday that its vertical content streaming app Tatedora is producing a live-action short adaptation of Miman 's Yuri Is My Job! ( Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto Desu! ) manga that will debut on the service in spring 2027. Daiki Nakayama is directing the project, with scripts by Nishioka To Neil.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Needs Another Sequel to Fix Its Biggest Mistakes That Can Save the Series
content: The Jujutsu Kaisen manga reached its controversial ending in September 2024, leaving behind several unanswered questions. The final battle went on for over a year, but the ending didn’t resolve several plot points .
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Demon Slayer
content: Demon Slayer ‘s groundbreaking global success is primarily thanks to the anime adaptation by Ufotable. While the manga was already a decent enough success, the anime adaptation helped it reach new heights of popularity that few series had gotten before.
author: ComicBook
